title: Citizens of God's kingdom; consists in removal of evils and positive goods
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Therefore man's highest beatitude stands as in God alone. The end belonging toward eternal life stands as God's glory. Fellowship belonging toward ye holy angels. another reason belonging toward ye decrees. ye reason belonging toward ye persons; what stands as natural in God; this vision if considered statically; God's essence stands as infinite; The vision belonging toward God stands as essential to beatitude. (4) It consists both in ye removal belonging toward contrary evils plus in ye access belonging toward positive goods — ye vision belonging toward God, glorification, fellowship belonging toward ye saints, joy. 11, &c.). (3) It belongs to ye citizens belonging toward God's kingdom (Heb.
pass_b_english: (3) It belongs to the citizens of God's kingdom (Heb. 11, &c.). (4) It consists both in the removal of contrary evils and in the access of positive goods — the vision of God, glorification, fellowship of the saints, joy. The vision of God is essential to beatitude. God's essence is infinite; this vision if considered statically; what is natural in God; the reason of the persons; another reason of the decrees. Fellowship of the holy angels. The end of eternal life is God's glory. Therefore man's highest beatitude is in God alone.
source_text: 3. Est civium regni Dei, Heb. 11 &c. 4. Consistit tum in malorum contrariorum remotione, tum in bonorum positivi accessu — visione Dei, glorificatione, consortio sanctorum, laetitia. Visio Dei est essentiale beatitudinis. Essentia Dei infinita; haec visio si stative consideretur; naturalia in Deo; personarum ratio; decretorum alia ratio. Consortium sanctorum angelorum. Vitae aeternae finis — Dei gloria. Summa igitur hominis beatitudo est in soli Deo.
